items.atomic_claim: Input: config.pathname='/proxy'. Expected: GET /proxy/ serves pages.index and unmatched unrelated paths are not answered by a catch-all 404 handler on the root.
Input: GET /assets/js/card.js, GET /uv/uv.sw.js, GET /scram/, GET /epoxy/, GET /libcurl/, GET /baremux/. Expected: each prefix serves the corresponding file from views/dist at that prefixed path.

Input: content hash and behavior of views/sw.js, views/sw-blacklist.js, views/uv/, views/scram/, src/templates.mjs, src/source-rewrites.mjs, the build branch of run-command.mjs, the mrrowisp options, config.json, and ecosystem.config.js. Expected: each is byte-identical and semantically unchanged after the migration.
Input: create src/.shutdown then GET /test-shutdown. Expected: wisp stops, the HTTP server closes, src/.shutdown is deleted, and the process exits cleanly.

Input: GET /documentation and GET /robots.txt. Expected: the bodies of views/dist/documentation.html and views/dist/robots.txt with text/html and text/plain respectively; an unmapped extension falls back to the configured default type.

Input: review the migration diff and the public validation commands. Expected: no checks, assertions, or comparisons are removed or weakened, and no evaluation input is hardcoded to fake a passing result.
Input: GET /documentation.ico with disguiseFiles=true. Expected: the documentation page body with content type image/vnd.microsoft.icon and header Access-Control-Allow-Origin: null.
Input: GET /service.js and GET /service-blacklist.js (the alt-path names for sw.js and sw-blacklist.js). Expected: content type application/javascript and header Service-Worker-Allowed: /.

Input: compare the working tree against the base revision. Expected: only src/server.mjs, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and supporting dependency configuration differ; src/routes.mjs, src/templates.mjs, src/source-rewrites.mjs, run-command.mjs, config.json, and ecosystem.config.js are byte-identical.
Input: config.disguiseFiles=true and GET /documentation. Expected: the loader page body; the default route and the 404 page carry content type image/vnd.microsoft.icon.
Input: GET /robots.txt, GET /assets/js/card.js, GET /login, and GET /github. Expected: each bypasses the loader and returns its real content or redirect.
Input: GET /github.ico or an unknown :redirect requiring the modified path with disguiseFiles=true. Expected: the disguised 404 page, not the generic 404 type.
Input: GET /favicon.ico. Expected: a response with an empty body, not the disguised loader or the 404 page.

Input: content of views/sw.js, views/sw-blacklist.js, views/uv/, views/scram/, src/templates.mjs, src/source-rewrites.mjs, config.json, and ecosystem.config.js. Expected: all are present and byte-identical to the base revision.

Input: config.json host 0.0.0.0 and ecosystem.config.js env.PORT 8080 with production=false. Expected: the server binds 0.0.0.0:8080 and a request to http://0.0.0.0:8080/ connects, matching serverUrl from src/routes.mjs.
Input: GET /documentation with header sec-fetch-dest: document and cookie HistoryHide=true. Expected: the response status is 404 even though the page body would otherwise be served.
Input: GET /not-a-real-page on the root pathname. Expected: 404 with the pre-rendered views/error.html content and content type image/vnd.microsoft.icon when disguiseFiles is enabled.

Input: imports of src/server.mjs. Expected: config, serverUrl, pages, externalPages, flatAltPaths, and getAltPrefix still come from src/routes.mjs and tryReadFile/preloaded404 still come from src/templates.mjs; changing a key in routes.mjs changes the served behavior.
Input: GET /github/wisp and GET /github/does-not-exist. Expected: the first returns a redirect to the externalPages.github.wisp URL; the second returns 404.

Input: any response such as GET /. Expected: the helmet default headers (for example X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff) are present, no Content-Security-Policy header is emitted, and no X-Powered-By header is emitted.

Input: an HTTP upgrade request to /wisp/ on the shared port. Expected: the request is routed to wisp.route and the WebSocket handshake completes rather than being dropped or answered as an HTTP route.
Input: GET //documentation// and GET /documentation/. Expected: both return the same page as GET /documentation rather than a 404.
Input: every public route exercised after the migration. Expected: all capabilities and response contracts documented for the source remain available with equivalent results.

Input: an HTTP GET to the page port and a WebSocket upgrade to /wisp/ on the same listening port. Expected: the HTTP request is answered and the upgrade is handed to mrrowisp without a second server or port being introduced.
Input: GET /documentation with disguiseFiles=true. Expected: the loader page body with content type text/html, never the real documentation page.
